criteria.intent: shout is implemented with a unit test that was run and passes, and the completion report says how the change was reviewed - an in-session diff pass is enough for a change this small

the request's one requirement is treated as the whole Fix set - beyond it, only Boy Scout tidies are edited (behavior-preserving fixes in a function the change edits and minor ones elsewhere, or an obvious small bug in an edited function fixed under a test), each named as one; anything else noticed is surfaced rather than fixed
the verified change is committed and the report names that commit, while no push or PR is made or claimed
